data.name: Jogi
data.gender_notes: Jogi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to a personal god or guru. The name Jogi carries the meaning “Devotee” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jogi usually hope their child will grow to embody devotee and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of deep devotion and faith.
data.etymology: Jogi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devotee.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jogi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Jogi, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jog', means a wanderer or a pilgrim on the spiritual path. It symbolizes an individual who has renounced worldly desires and is devoted to the pursuit of self-realization and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jogi was a title given to wandering ascetics in medieval India The name Jogi carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Jogi was a title given to wandering ascetics in medieval India, often associated with the Bhakti movement. They were known for their devotion to a personal deity and were not bound by the rigid rules of the caste system.

trends: Used as a surname in India, particularly in the states of Punjab and Haryana
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jogi has evolved over time and is now used as a surname in India, particularly in the states of Punjab and Haryana. It is also used on social media and genealogy websites as a search term or identifier.
